# html2canvas

- Version: 1.4.1
- Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/html2canvas/v/1.4.1
- Licence: MIT (see `LICENSE` in this directory)
- Local use: browser-only PNG generation for the Skin Profile summary card

The minified production file is bundled locally. The website does not load this dependency from a third-party CDN and does not upload generated images.
